title: W10322959 — Service Test Mode (S-E) entry
description: Enter Jazz Service Test Mode for component tests 1–9.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Jazz French Door Refrigerator (W10322959B, 19–22 cu ft)

steps.title: Enter Service Test Mode
steps.body: Hold refrigerator door light switch closed. Press Refrigerator UP 3 times within 10 seconds. Release door switch — display shows S-E. Press Refrigerator UP once more to confirm. Software version displays 3 seconds; freezer then shows first test number. Close door to exit at any time.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Refrigerator Temperature UP /+ keypad 3 times consecutively.
